cards.name: Marshall.D.Teach
cards.text:
Your [On Play] effects are negated.
[Activate: Main] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Your opponent's [On Play] effects are negated until the end of your opponent's next turn.

cards.text: [Activate: Main] You may rest this Character: If your Leader has the {Blackbeard Pirates} type, give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters 3 cost during this turn.[On K.O.] Draw 1 card.
